files.description: Quiz results (80 rows, one per student in seat order, no other columns): quiz_a and quiz_b (points 0-10, whole numbers, many equal values; about 9% and 6% of cells empty for absent students).

task_text: The pass marks are 6 points for quiz_a and 5 points for quiz_b. An empty cell means the student was absent, and an absent student did not reach the pass mark. How many students reached the pass mark in both quizzes? `result` should be that number.
intended_computation: Number of rows with quiz_a >= 6 and quiz_b >= 5, both non-empty.

predicted_direction.reason: On 2.x an absent student's comparison was False, so all(axis=1) excluded them; on 3.1 it is missing and all() skips it, so students absent in one quiz who passed the other are counted.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row N05; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
